Job Title:
Geospatial Information Systems (GIS) Analyst

Location:
6315 Bren Mar Drive, Alexandria, VA 22312

Summary:
The GIS Analyst supports the Operations Center by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing geospatial data to maintain situational awareness, inform decision-making, and support incident response and reporting. The analyst develops and maintains GIS products and applications, collaborates with partners, and provides training and technical guidance on geospatial tools and capabilities.

Responsibilities:

Collect, analyze, and interpret geographic information from geodetic surveys, aerial imagery, and satellite data.
Research, develop, and maintain maps and other spatial data in digital and graphic formats for legal, social, political, educational, design, and operational purposes.
Design and evaluate algorithms, data structures, and user interfaces to support GIS and mapping systems, as required.
Maintain the GIS database and ensure that all data layers are accurate, relevant, and regularly updated.
Configure, maintain, and enhance ESRI portal applications, including Web AppBuilder, Survey123, Workforce, and StoryMaps.
Develop and modify GIS applications and tools to support Operations Center and mission requirements.
Maintain GIS portal Group membership and archive outdated or unused materials and drafts.
Maintain situational awareness of related events, incidents, and threats.
Maintain and update the Common Operating Picture (COP) with relevant geospatial information.
Provide GIS support for incident reporting, briefings, and Requests for Information (RFIs).
Prepare executive-level geospatial products and reports, including Senior Leader Briefs as directed by the Senior Watch Officer (SWO).
Produce routine and ad hoc reporting products and briefings to support operational decision-making.
Coordinate with other programs that have geospatial elements (e.g., MIST, telematics, and similar initiatives).
Coordinate with the Geospatial Center of Excellence on the use and integration of provided geospatial capabilities, both current and emerging.
Train watch standers and personnel on the use of GIS applications, tools, and products.
Provide ongoing technical support and user assistance for GIS-related systems and workflows.

Requirements:

Minimum of 5 years of experience in geographic information systems analysis or closely related work.
Proficiency in GIS analysis, map production, and spatial data management.
Demonstrated experience with ESRI products, including the ability to configure, modify, or program within ESRI portal applications (Web AppBuilder, Survey123, Workforce, StoryMaps).
Strong skills in developing visual and graphic products, including advanced presentation development for executive audiences.
Ability to perform all functional duties independently in an operational environment.
Bachelor's (BA/BS) or Master's (MA/MS) degree in Geography, GIS, Geospatial Science, Cartography, Computer Science, or a related field.
Active Secret security clearance is required for this position.

new_jobs.title: Behavioral Health Program Coordinator # 26-18618
new_jobs.description:
Duration: 12 Months

Job Description
Under the direction of the Supervisor - Behavioral Health, the Program Coordinator - Behavioral Health is responsible for the daily management of non-clinical reviews that support the clinical, business, and program-related work of the department.
The Program Coordinator functions as a key member of the Behavioral Health Utilization Management (BH UM) team and represents Client Health values through professional written and verbal communication with both internal and external customers.

Key Responsibilities:

Pre-Clinical Review Validation
Review incoming referrals and obtain required demographic information.
Verify member eligibility.
Identify special coverage or quality events and route cases appropriately.

Review Workflow Management
Manage departmental review workflows.
Create and manage review events within clinical systems, including: MHK
CaseTrakker
Jiva/Ecare

Monitor review status and ensure timely processing.

Coverage Review
Perform basic coverage reviews for a defined subset of requests, including: Inpatient services
Outpatient therapy
ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis)
CBHI/BHCA (Behavioral Health Services for Children and Adolescents)
Psychological and neuropsychological testing
rTMS (Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation)
Other levels of care as assigned

Update requests, obtain additional clinical information, or void requests when appropriate.

Operational & Administrative Support
Participate in departmental operational and administrative processes.
Respond to requests for departmental information and follow up as needed.
Participate in departmental projects and special assignments to support timeliness, quality, and compliance.
Represent the department on committees when required.
Perform other administrative duties and special projects as assigned.
